content: Appendix F: Complete N−1 contingency screening catalogue

This archive contains all 2,208 contingent outage records (24 hours × 46 outages × 2 policies). Columns report the solver verdict and electrical metrics only where the AC solution converged. A dash on a nonconvergent row is not a compliant or physically measured value. Original CSVs retain voltage extremes, delta counts, exact precision and timestamps.
